answer:
Subject: Schedule Adjustment Request – Medical Accommodation  

Hi Tom Reyes,

I’m writing to let you know that I was recently diagnosed with type 1 diabetes at Hanbit Clinic. As I work with my care team to stabilize my treatment plan over the next two months, I would appreciate an adjustable schedule (e.g., flexible start/end times, occasional remote work, or modified break periods) to accommodate medical appointments and monitoring needs.

I remain fully committed to my responsibilities and will ensure coverage for any shifted hours. Could we set up a brief time this week to discuss a practical arrangement? I’m available at jane.park@example.com or 010-5555-0142 to coordinate.

Thank you for your understanding and support.

Best regards,  
Jane Park
